diagnosis: Foreground MainActivity had a bounded body reader, but RiskWorker.get still used unlimited BufferedReader.readLine. Continuous bytes without a newline can block risk checks, static fallback and the subsequent update reminder despite idle readTimeout. Reproduced with a synthetic slow local HTTP server; not proof of the cause of earlier phone incidents.
